name: The Black Iron Prison Vision
summary: PKD reports a recurring vision in which 1974 California is overlaid by 70 AD Rome — a vast iron prison housing the early Christians under imperial persecution. The vision continued at intervals through 1981.
Deepens Exegesis reflection on simulation theory, the prison-like structure of reality, and the coaxial world behind appearances.
notes: Recast from generic vision to gnostic experience because the event is about hidden structure, imprisonment, and epistemic breakthrough.

name: Twin Sister Jane Dream Appearances
summary: Across the late period (1980-1981), PKD reports recurring dreams in which his twin sister Jane (who died in infancy) appears, addresses him, and is in some way fused with the AI Voice he has heard since 1974.
